title: "Unsupervised learning": entropy and number of bins

cues.en: Presenter: So here we have another unsupervised learning challenge.
cues.zh: 講者：這裡又有一個「非監督式學習」挑戰。

cues.en: This is another opportunity for you to gain some experience with coding and also gain some more intuition about concepts in statistics.
cues.zh: 這是另一個機會，讓你累積程式經驗，也對統計概念建立更多直覺。

cues.en: In this case, we are particularly focused on entropy.
So what you want to do in this code challenge is basically reproduce a plot that looks like this.
cues.zh: 這個程式挑戰，基本上就是重現一張像這樣的圖。

cues.en: So what are we looking at here?
Well, on the y-axis, is entropy, and on the x-axis is the number of bins used to discretize the data.
cues.zh: Y 軸是熵，X 軸是將資料離散化時使用的區間數。

cues.en: So I made this plot using exactly these data that I showed you here, so the Brownian noise, and, basically, all you're going to do
cues.zh: 我用的就是這裡展示過的同一組資料，也就是布朗雜訊。基本上，你要做的

cues.en: is systematically change the number of bins from, it looks like this is 4 bins, I guess, and then we go up to 50 bins.
cues.zh: 就是有系統地改變區間數，看起來這裡應該從 4 個區間開始，一直到 50 個區間。

cues.en: So from 4 to 50 bins, change the number of bins for discretizing in the histogram, and then compute entropy.
cues.zh: 所以從 4 到 50，改變直方圖進行離散化時使用的區間數，然後計算熵。

cues.en: And then you need to save the entropy for each of those bins.
cues.zh: 接著，儲存每種區間數所對應的熵。

cues.en: And, remember, you don't want to change the data.
So once you generate the data, it's exactly the same data.
cues.zh: 資料一旦產生，就必須一直使用完全相同的資料。

cues.en: Otherwise, if it's different data, then that's a confound.
cues.zh: 否則，如果換了不同資料，就會引入混淆因素。

cues.en: So exactly the same data set.
cues.zh: 所以要使用完全相同的資料集。

cues.en: You just change the number of bins and show that the entropy, the estimate of entropy, is highly dependent on the number of bins
cues.zh: 只改變區間數，展示熵，也就是熵的估計值，高度取決於

cues.en: that you get for the histogram.
cues.zh: 直方圖所使用的區間數。
